# M Ramzan — Web & Mobile App Developer (Pakistan)

> M Ramzan provides website development, WordPress CMS websites, custom web
> applications (React/Next.js), Flutter mobile apps, website redesign, and
> SEO/AEO optimization for small businesses (SMEs) and startups in Pakistan.
> Packages start from PKR 30,000. Contact via WhatsApp or the site's contact
> form for a quote.

## Key facts

- Name: M Ramzan (Muhammad Ramzan)
- Role: Web & Mobile Application Developer
- Location: Pakistan (remote & local projects)
- Website: https://mramzan.dev
- Starting price: PKR 30,000 (Starter Business Website)
- Core stack: WordPress, HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Flutter
- Primary audience: Pakistani SMEs — salons, clinics, consultants, shops, startups, foundations
- Contact: info@mramzan.dev | WhatsApp: +92 309 6734231
